item.title: AI 101 with Brandon Leshchinskiy
item.description: This is a video of Brandon Leshchinskiy’s presentation “AI 101,” which provides an introductory overview of the application of artificial intelligence in solving real-world problems: which tasks machine learning handles well, how it works, and what its shortcomings are.
